names.plain: Tumour with a rim of normal gland

gloss: The tumour and a thin cuff of normal gland tissue around it, on the outer side of the facial nerve: the piece removed in extracapsular dissection. The width of the cuff is illustrative.
role: Extracapsular dissection takes out the tumour with a thin rim of normal gland, without searching for the facial nerve.
matters: Some surgeons argue that for a benign tumour a cuff of normal gland, not the whole outer lobe, is all that is needed, so the extent is a judgement.
